outline.description:
Gastro‑logical examination informs design choices:
• Why fast convergence appears inherent.
• What the orientation change priorized over magnitude explains latent level distribution.
• Trade‑off insights between flexibility versus enforceable regularity.
subtopics:
+ “Parameter efficiency comparison”: COFT/OFT carry far fewer trainable variables than Full Fine‑Tune yet stay tighter than LoRA adapters.
+ “No runtime penalty”: After training finish multiply R into W⁰ producing canonical weight ready for inference.
+ “Robustness”: COFT’s proximity constraint dampens catastrophic collapse previously observed.
+ “Connection | contrast”: Revisit adapter theory → arithmetic separator interaction between additive low rank updates vs multiplicative global rotations.
+ “Potential for compound rotations”: Multiplying multiple learnt rotations preserves joint knowledge under bounded ε configuration.
